scope: Fixed open elliptic curve, odd generalized Jacobian/Picard 1-motive, puncture residue direction, mixed Cartier coordinates, and the full moving ordinary-j=2 affine gate

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The five-dimensional odd de Rham module of U=E\D is the realization, up to standard duality, of the fixed Picard 1-motive [L^- -> E] with d_k=[P_k]-[-P_k] and u(d_k)=2P_k.
claims.evidence: report Sections 1-2; residue exact sequence and genus-one Abel-Jacobi map
claims.scope_limit: the displayed split basis is over Q(sqrt(2),zeta_3) and descends as a Galois lattice

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For omega_log=omega_1, the residue divisor is (3 beta)^(-1)(d_0+zeta^2 d_1+zeta d_2).
claims.evidence: report equations (1.7) and (3.1); exact partial-fraction certificate
claims.scope_limit: residue coefficients are written after choosing beta and zeta in the splitting field

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The only odd algebraic-unit direction is d_0+d_1+d_2, with dlog((Y-beta)/(Y+beta))=3 beta omega_2; omega_1 is not a unit logarithm.
claims.scope_limit: the statement concerns units on the punctured curve after algebraic closure

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The boundary point P maps to (2,2) on y^2=x^3-4 and is non-torsion; hence the two nonconstant cubic residue characters are non-torsion elliptic third-kind directions.
claims.scope_limit: elliptic-logarithmic origin does not itself give a p-adic valuation or density theorem

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The pair (H_q,h_q), every cutoff H_q-K_delta h_q, and the full period H_q-D_r h_q are exact Cartier matrix coefficients of the fixed mixed realization, with a row-dependent input vector.
claims.evidence: report Sections 4-5; 1,153 cutoff and 1,153 full-vector certificate identities
claims.scope_limit: affine constants require adjoining a trivial line; the rank-zero gate branch remains separate

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_NO_GO
claims.claim: On p=5 mod 6, a p-dependent frame change puts the whole odd Cartier module in a normal form independent of H_q and h_q; scalar and conjugacy invariants therefore cannot recover the actual fixed-frame gate coefficient.
claims.evidence: report equation (1.9); exact normal-form certificate identities
claims.scope_limit: does not erase the canonical fixed-frame period or the endpoint functional

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_NO_GO
claims.claim: On p=1 mod 6 the extension coefficient is removable off resonance h_q=epsilon; at resonance only its Jordan zero/nonzero status is intrinsic, while the full gate still uses the different moving coefficient H_q-D_r h_q.
claims.scope_limit: no assertion about the density of resonant primes

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The finite punctured endpoint functional does not descend to de Rham cohomology in either phase.
claims.evidence: Lambda(L(X^-1))=-epsilon and 30 d_0+12 d_1=epsilon; report equations (6.2)-(6.3)
claims.scope_limit: this is an all-prime obstruction to the scalar shortcut, not to every crystalline method

claims.label: OPEN_NOT_EQUIVALENCE
claims.claim: No if-and-only-if between the full gate and a basis-free elliptic-Wieferich or p-adic elliptic-logarithm condition is proved; Wieferich language remains analogy only.
claims.scope_limit: an integral/crystalline refinement could still supply new arithmetic

claims.label: EXACT_FINITE_ONLY
claims.claim: The standard-library checker verifies geometry, group law, residues, unit kernel, Cartier coefficients, normal forms, endpoints, cutoffs, and full vectors on bounded ranges without an exceptional-zero search.

claims.label: PROVED_BOOKING_DECISION
claims.claim: The moving-vector and endpoint/conjugacy obstructions fail the positive-linear-capacity admission test; Item 267 books zero new Route-1 rate and zero ordinary-j=2 capacity reduction.
claims.scope_limit: Route 1 and every conclusion about e+pi remain open
